text:
- Use named arm; if none, start on bottle side. Grasp body centre across narrow side, top-down or tilted; retry same body-centre if grasp fails before changing arm/part.
- Lift to ~15-25 cm; avoid end grasps when upright is needed.
- Shake with dz +/-5 cm for at least 3 full cycles, xy fixed. If a move PLAN_FAILs, retry with smaller dz (e.g. 4 cm) and continue cycles.
- Do not place/release: whatever the sentence says about putting it down afterwards, the task ends with the bottle still held and raised well above the table after shaking; call done after verifying holding and height (add upright if passing).
- Always end with done; never output None/null.
goal: End holding the bottle raised well above the table after shaking (even if the sentence mentions putting it down).
